scope: Staging-only manual QA of typed product metafield value save, readback, validation and cleanup. No live/production actions.

checks.evidence: Saved 'Staging QA round-trip 2026-10-10'; after app reload and data load, the resource value field displayed the exact saved string.

Clicked Remove value and confirmed the staging-only removal dialog. After reload and data load, the value field was empty, Save value and Remove value were disabled, and the app displayed 'Value removed.'
Entered 'ab' and attempted Save. The app displayed 'Text violates min length 3.' and Remove value remained disabled. Cleared the unsaved draft; no value was written.

On The Complete Snowboard, selected the existing Page (QA) definition, searched for Contact, and selected it from the app picker. The editor populated a typed Shopify Page GID; save returned 'Value saved.' After a full app reload and reselecting the same product/definition, the exact GID was read back. Removed the temporary value; the app confirmed 'Value removed.'

On The Complete Snowboard, selected the existing File (QA) definition, searched for snowboard, and selected an existing ready media image from the app picker. The editor populated a typed Shopify MediaImage GID; save returned 'Value saved.' After a full app reload and reselecting the same product/definition, the exact GID was read back. Removed the temporary value; the app confirmed 'Value removed.'

Two staging app tabs loaded the same empty Page (QA) value on The Complete Snowboard. The first tab saved Contact. The second tab submitted its pre-change snapshot and received “Value changed since you loaded it. Reload before editing.” The first tab's saved value remained present; after the test it was removed, and after reload the QA value field was empty.

limitations: Manual staging UI evidence covers one existing page and one existing media file on one product; it does not replace automated tests or broader end-to-end acceptance.
No screenshot artifact was retained in the repository.
No live deployment, production data change, theme publish or app release was performed.
Stale-write coverage is one page-reference case; invalid/conflict behavior across other supported value types and broader automated/end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
